reason: Provides native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness thinking, permission-request, completion, and idle states through an always-on-top popup.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生桌面状态通知，在思考、请求权限和完成时显示置顶弹窗并可播放系统提示音。
summaries.en: Provides native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness thinking, permission-request, and completion states through an always-on-top popup with optional system sounds.

capabilities: Monitors DeepSeek Harness session and approval events
Runs a local status HTTP endpoint on loopback
Launches a native desktop popup window
Displays status changes and plays system sounds
